                        if delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and best_move is not None and (i, p, j, q, a, b) < best_move[0]):
                            best_delta = delta
                            best_move = ((i, p, j, q, a, b), ("swap", ri_removed[:p] + [b] + ri_removed[p:], rj_removed[:q] + [a] + rj_removed[q:]))
        if best_move is not None and best_delta < 0:
            (i, p, j, q, a, b), (_, new_i, new_j) = best_move
            routes[i] = new_i
            routes[j] = new_j
            loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
            routes = [r for r in routes if r]
            loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
            changed = True
            continue

        if not changed:
            break

    # Final cleanup: intra-route 2-opt once more
    for i in range(len(routes)):
        nr, _ = two_opt_best(routes[i])
        routes[i] = nr

    routes = [r for r in routes if r]
    return routes
